title: From status quo to status woah

location.extent: Complete published video; PNG is one poster frame

slide_intent: Turn a familiar phrase into a surprise so the promise of change is felt as well as read.
strategic_value: A small verbal substitution paired with celebratory imagery can give Wise’s challenge to conventional finance a playful tone.
demonstration: On pink, dark stacked wording changes from From Status Quo to To Status Woah; colorful ribbon and confetti sweep across the second phrase.
practical_value: Compare how wordplay and a timed reveal can communicate change without a long explanation.
